chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام

about a man who prays two rakʿahs of the obligatory prayer and does not sit in them. He said: “If he remembers while he is standing in the third, then let him sit; and if he does not remember until he has bowed, then let him complete his salat, then perform two sajdahs while sitting before speaking.”

key_terms.يَجْلِسُ: to sit for the prescribed sitting in prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets the sitting after two rakʿahs in an obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about forgetfulness in salat when the worshipper omits the sitting after two rakʿahs in an obligatory prayer. If he remembers before going into rukuʿ of the third rakʿah, he returns to sit; if he remembers only after bowing, he completes the prayer and then performs two sajdahs of sahw before speaking.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1026 - Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

about a man who prays two rak'ahs of the obligatory prayer but does not sit in them.
Imam (as) said: "If he remembers while standing in the third rak'ah, he should sit. If he does not remember until he has already bowed, he should complete his prayer, then prostrate two prostrations while sitting before speaking."
